Name: HD Portraits Template
Author: Lokelios
Description:
[center][size=5][b]MAJOR UPDATE- CLEANED UP CONTENT.JSON AND ADDED MORE EXPANSION INTEGRATION
[/b][/size]I apologize for being so absent. I've been busy with life so I've not been able to play Stardew Valley, Let alone make any updates on this mod. However, I got some free time and Managed to make a decent update to the mod!
I just wanna say a major Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/47185703]FenrirReaper[/url] for actually compiling the characters and giving a list of characters in alphabetical order in the posts! Genuinely, without you, I don't think I would have been able to actually clean up the content.json as well as it is. Thank you so, so much for providing the link to the list!! Now there should be No Missing characters, or Repeated characters!

An added update is I have added integration for [b]two more expansion mods!!!
[/b]The Mods in question being [b]Welcome To Mineral Town[/b], and [b]Stoffon[/b]!!

And finally, I decided to make Multiple versions of the Portrait Template for those who want all of those expansions in their template, OR those who only want Vanilla game, SVE, RSV + Custom NPC June. I've only done this with those three mods because those are the two most well known expansions, June is a very easy addition, and I unfortunately don't have the time as of yet to make separated versions of the other expansions as of yet. But hopefully, one day I can.

I also want to say thank you to everyone who's downloaded this mod and used it. I'm very inexperienced at any type of coding, and I know this mod was kind of rough around the edges, especially at first. But I really appreciate everyone still giving it a chance and even helping me with problems so I could try to sort them out. I know it may not seem like a huge deal, but this really was a first for me. So thank you, again.


-----

Just as the title and sub says!
If you're someone who doesn't have the time to do Portrait modding, or, like me, Modding and coding is difficult to grasp but you really want to play the game with custom, Hi-Res Portraits and the best option is to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HDPortraits[/url] then this mod is for you!!

I personally really like to use hi-res custom portraits with Stardew Valley, and with Portraiture seeming to become obsolete due to it's dependency on PyTK﻿ in the forseeable future, I switched over to swyrl's HD Portrait mod! However, this also meant I had to learn how to construct a mod all on my own. Which was admittedly difficult, even if it seemed to basic to figure out.

But Nonetheless, I managed to do it! And I decided that I wanted to share this as a template for others who either don't want to make their own portrait mod, or just can't seem to have the time or ability to do so!

And all you have to do is pop your portrait PNGs into the "assets" folder of the mod! I've even pre-added integration for [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], [b]Lunna Astray In Stardew Valley[/b], [b]DownTown Zuzu,[/b] [b]Adventurer's Guild Expanded, Stoffon, Mineral Town, And Boarding House!

[/b]Which means all you have to do is pop portraits for characters in there for respective characters from those mods too!

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] THE PORTRAITS NEED TO HAVE A WIDTH OF [b]512px[/b] OR ELSE THE PORTRAITS WILL APPEAR TOO SMALL IN-GAME. IF YOU HAVE A PORTRAIT PNG THAT IS SMALLER THAN THAT. RESIZE THE PICTURE TO MAKE SURE THE WIDTH IS [b]512px[/b], AND KEEP THE ASPECT RATIO SO THE HEIGHT IS AUTO-CONFIGURED.

This is actually my first ever mod in any form, and when I played the game, I didn't run into any problems, but I'll do my best to look into any issues one may have!

Bonus Note: The Portrait Of Sebastian Used In The Image(s) is actually my very own! I may or may not release it in the future, unsure yet.[/center]
